semantics.alias_rule: fresh backend-owned storage; no input aliases
semantics.shape_rule: one input preserves its vector shape; two or more inputs produce [product(lengths), input_count]; zero-length inputs produce zero rows
semantics.dtype_rule: all inputs have one identical canonical dtype, preserved exactly
semantics.layout_rule: logical rank-one input traversal and contiguous output
semantics.device_rule: co-located CPU ordinal zero and one source stream
semantics.numeric_rule: itertools.product order with the last input varying fastest and byte-exact scalar copying
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded input and row boundaries, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: forward-only for the cataloged I64 position-grid call; integral inputs have no gradient
semantics.jvp_rule: forward-only for the cataloged I64 position-grid call; integral inputs have no tangent
